And the sooner we get these flaky explosives off our backs, which is fine by&hellip;|An [[unidentified zone runner]] to [[Wyl Tarson|Wyl]] and [[Ved Tarson]], shortly before his [[Death/Legends|death]].|<ref name="Rebellion 6">[[Rebellion 6|''Rebellion'' 6]]</ref>}}
'''Zone runners''' were agile guerrilla fighters who performed hit-and-run attacks against heavier and slower enemy forces.<ref name="Rebellion 6" />

The role of zone runners on the battlefield typically required them to get into close proximity to mobile enemy targets on foot. After attempting to destroy or disable their targets with well-thrown [[Bomb/Legends|explosive satchels]], they would then run for cover. Instead of [[Armor/Legends|armor]], which would only slow them down, zone runners relied upon their speed and reflexes to keep enemy forces from drawing a bead on them.<ref name="Rebellion 6" />

Before he became a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], [[Wyl Tarson]] and his older brother [[Ved Tarson|Ved]] fought as zone runners for an unidentified resistance movement on a similarly unidentified [[Planet/Legends|world]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rebellion 6" />
